operatorNotes: The window is WINDOW_COMPLETE with no pause. All five precommitted items were started, executed exactly once and completed, every one of them produced raw page evidence well above the P5 minimum of four, and no P1-P8 arm fired at any of the six gate evaluations.

This is the first window executed under the post-Child-Window-A continuation decision. Under Owner Clarification Q4 it began with fresh window-local P1, P2, P3 and P5 counters; Child Window A's P5 count was neither carried into it nor erased from the record.

Four of the five items ended at PAGE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with exactly 35 page attempts, which is the frozen MAX_PAGE_ATTEMPTS_PER_ROOT ceiling reached rather than exceeded. P:49 also ended at PAGE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED but produced only 15 pages from 35 attempts, so twenty of its attempts did not yield an eligible 2xx HTML page with a resolvable charset.

Two transport errors occurred and neither is an item-level failure: P:47 and P:48 each recorded one TLS_FAILURE on a /robots.txt request against a SIBLING host discovered during the run, not against the item's root. The root policy resolved in both cases, the window robots-refusal count stayed at zero, and both items still yielded 33 and 30 raw pages.

P:49 is the only item whose SD7 count is a genuine range, [11, 15], and the cause is recorded rather than resolved: four of its fifteen pages are SHORT TEXT under the landed near-duplicate pass and are therefore unresolved. The range is preserved complete and is never forced to an exact value. Both ends are at or above four, so no adjudication ambiguity arises from it.
P:48 is the only item with near-duplicate edges (9) and P:50 the only item with exact-duplicate groups (2). Both reduce the post-SD7 count below the raw count, and both stay far above four.

Five candidate rows across the window carry a negative score, minimum -3.0000. Migration 0008 dropped migration 0007's CHECK (candidate_score >= 0) exactly so that the signed score the landed scorer produces can persist; this window is the first live exercise of that in the working database, and it inserted without error.

The two capability limits Child Window A exposed were carried forward unrepaired, as the owner's review conclusion requires. Neither was encountered here: no item read a robots.txt redirect to a non-/robots.txt path, and no item failed DNS.

AC power was attached throughout. The bound power policy makes AC preferred and not required with a 21% floor, so the battery-only authorisation was available but was not needed. No sleep, wake or DarkWake event occurred at any point in the acquisition interval.

validation.command: caffeinate -dimsu bash -c '<120-second correctness-critical quiet gate>; npm run validate'

quietGateDetectorDefect.observed: the gate's own detector pattern (a pgrep over 'vitest' and 'npm run validate') matched the gate's OWN caffeinate/bash wrapper, whose command line contains the literal string 'npm run validate'. It therefore logged a reset on all 120 iterations
quietGateDetectorDefect.consequenceForTiming: none: the reset could not shorten a for-loop over a fixed 120-element sequence, so the full 120 one-second iterations elapsed before validate was chained, 14:14:22Z to 14:16:28Z
quietGateDetectorDefect.consequenceForDetection: the detector could NOT have distinguished a genuine external validate or vitest from itself, so it provides no independent evidence of quiet. That is stated rather than glossed
quietGateDetectorDefect.howQuietWasActuallyEstablished: by direct process inspection immediately before the gate (a scan for vitest, npm run validate and orgunits discover returned nothing), by the single-canonical-writer rule for this lineage, and by the validate run itself completing exit 0 with no contamination symptom
